newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bid talk fires up UAP shares.
newsitem.headline: Bid talk fires up UAP shares.

text.p: Shares in Union des Assurances de Paris (UAP) traded sharply higher on Friday on renewed takeover rumours, with one broker saying Axa could announce the acquisition as soon as next Monday.
UAP stock was up 6.36 percent at 117 francs at 1540 GMT, while AXA was down 1.46 percent at 317.
UAP has previously denied the bid rumours which have persisted for weeks. pnt
Shares in Banque Nationale de Paris (BNP) initially dipped before recovering on the rumours, as the bank would take a capital loss on its UAP stake if the acquisition went through, traders said.
Shares in Assurances Generales de France (AGF) rose in sympathy with UAP, gaining 0.9 percent to 157.4 francs.
A feature article in business newspaper l'Agefi on Friday help reheat the bid speculation and gave a range of 80 to 155 francs per UAP share for an acquisition.
